content:
Originally a production plant owned by the Abraxodyne Chemical company prior to the Great War, this location became the nesting ground of a large number of Burning Deathclaws in the years after the war. The location would come to the attention of The Rust King, who was in search of a worthy fight. Upon arriving with his army, the Rust King was beset by the Deathclaw inhabitants of the plant. While the King himself battled the Deathclaw Matriarch, his soldiers suffered heavy casualties fighting the creatures. The Rust King was injured, gaining a large scar on his chest as well as losing his left eye to the matriarch. Eventually, the Rust King overpowered the matriarch, tearing its head from its body and causing the surviving Deathclaws to flee into the wastes, leaving behind their eggs. These eggs became the first of the Rust King's tamed Deathclaws.[1]

The Abraxodyne plant was fortified, and transformed into the capital of the newly founded Rust Kingdom, from which The Rust King rules much of Burning Springs, Ohio.[2] The interior of the facility serves as an arena, where individuals fight for the Rust King's amusement.[3]

↑"The Rust King isn't like a normal man, he's able to go wherever he pleases without fear of radiation poisoning or death. Over time, raiders began to follow him for his strength and slowly his army grew. Hearing rumors of a nest of Deathclaws in the old Abraxodyne Chemical plant, the Rust King headed south to conquer.

Upon entering, the Deathclaws attacked. The fight was brutal, many of the Rust King's men died and the Rust King himself sustained wounds that would have killed lesser men. Even as his chest bled and half his vision gouged out, the Rust King fought the Matriarch, eventually managing to break its neck and rip the creature's head off.

With the Matriarch dead, the surviving Deathclaw fled into the Wasteland, abandoning the nest and the eggs still within. The eggs abandoned in the nest were then adopted by the Rust King and later became the first of the Rust Kingdom's tamed Deathclaws." (The Rust Kingdom (Location) Terminal Entries#Founding our home)

↑"The Rust Kingdom took over much of Ohio eventually reaching the river that bordered Appalachia. Seeing potential in the new land, the Rust King sent scouts to confirm if the land was worthy of claiming.

Upon their return, they reported that the land was weak. The people were sick with an unknown disease and the non-infected were weak-willed, worshipping a bug for strength. The King decided that Appalachia was not worth the time to conquer, at least for now.

These bug worshippers followed some of our scouts to the canyon road just west of the river and attacked them. To stop the cultist nuisance and indicate the kingdom's border, the king commanded a wall be built within the canyon entrance. In the end; a mighty fortress was constructed.

↑The Rust King: "I give them a great honor. They kneel and use their bare hands to build my kingdom, or serve as entertainment in the arena." (The Rust King/Dialogue)
